imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel.name: Agent Kernel
imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel.description: A local memory and governance layer for the AI coding agents developers already use.
imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel.problem: Coding agents repeatedly lose repository context, repeat rejected mistakes, and weaken architecture boundaries across sessions.
imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel.goal: Keep durable local memory, reviewed rules, failure lessons, and architecture controls around existing coding agents without replacing them.
imMamdouhaboammar/agent-kernel.audience: Developers and teams using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, or AGENTS.md-compatible tools.

imMamdouhaboammar/delegate-team.name: Delegate Team
imMamdouhaboammar/delegate-team.description: A CLI that routes coding tasks through selected local agent workflows and optional governance checks.
imMamdouhaboammar/delegate-team.problem: One chat or one coding agent is often treated as the entire team, even when research, implementation, review, and verification need different workflows.
imMamdouhaboammar/delegate-team.goal: Route bounded tasks to the right local coding agents while keeping permissions, evidence, and final judgment explicit.
imMamdouhaboammar/delegate-team.audience: Developers coordinating ChatGPT Web, Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other local coding CLIs.

imMamdouhaboammar/unslop-preflight.name: Unslop Preflight
imMamdouhaboammar/unslop-preflight.description: A preflight quality gate and bounded repair loop for AI-built frontend repositories.
imMamdouhaboammar/unslop-preflight.problem: AI-generated frontends can look finished while hiding accessibility errors, fragile layout fixes, sample-data leaks, and repeatable visual regressions.
imMamdouhaboammar/unslop-preflight.goal: Detect common frontend slop before shipping, apply only low-risk deterministic repairs, and leave evidence for the remaining human review.
imMamdouhaboammar/unslop-preflight.audience: Vibe coders, frontend developers, agencies, and coding agents preparing React, Vue, or web projects for handoff.

imMamdouhaboammar/Riftbook.name: Riftbook
imMamdouhaboammar/Riftbook.description: A curated field guide for builders who use AI coding agents in real projects.
imMamdouhaboammar/Riftbook.problem: Useful agent tools, prompts, skills, lessons, and review practices are scattered, while many collections provide links without an operating workflow.
imMamdouhaboammar/Riftbook.goal: Organize practical AI-assisted building knowledge into clear routes, tested tools, reusable skills, and real workflow stories.
imMamdouhaboammar/Riftbook.audience: Beginners, solo builders, frontend developers, agency operators, and experienced coding-agent users.

imMamdouhaboammar/Growth-Hacker-Skills.name: Growth Hacker Skills
imMamdouhaboammar/Growth-Hacker-Skills.description: A connected agent-skill network for research, positioning, content, creative production, and performance review.
imMamdouhaboammar/Growth-Hacker-Skills.problem: Marketing work loses context whenever it moves from research to strategy, copy, design, publishing, and analysis through isolated prompts.
imMamdouhaboammar/Growth-Hacker-Skills.goal: Carry approved evidence and decisions through specialist marketing skills with explicit routing and handoff contracts.
imMamdouhaboammar/Growth-Hacker-Skills.audience: Growth marketers, content teams, agencies, founders, and AI agents producing connected marketing work.

imMamdouhaboammar/kaku-chatgpt-harness.name: Kaku ChatGPT Harness
imMamdouhaboammar/kaku-chatgpt-harness.description: A project-scoped local control plane for authenticated ChatGPT coding sessions through Kaku Terminal on macOS.
imMamdouhaboammar/kaku-chatgpt-harness.problem: Remote terminal access becomes unsafe and unreliable when sessions lack clear authentication, project boundaries, capability policies, and regression tests.
imMamdouhaboammar/kaku-chatgpt-harness.goal: Give ChatGPT a bounded local coding path with short-lived leases, safe process execution, private logs, verification, and rollback.
imMamdouhaboammar/kaku-chatgpt-harness.audience: macOS developers connecting ChatGPT to Kaku Terminal for controlled local repository work.

imMamdouhaboammar/dokion.name: Dokion
imMamdouhaboammar/dokion.description: A user-directed hardening runtime that executes an explicit software repair playbook across coding agents.
imMamdouhaboammar/dokion.problem: Hardening work drifts when agents choose tools, reorder checks, or claim readiness without durable evidence and bounded rollback.
imMamdouhaboammar/dokion.goal: Let the user own the hardening playbook while Dokion validates execution, journals evidence, verifies repairs, and restores rejected changes.
imMamdouhaboammar/dokion.audience: Developers using Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and shell tools for repeatable software hardening.

imMamdouhaboammar/vibe-svgs.name: Vibe SVGs
imMamdouhaboammar/vibe-svgs.description: An accessible collection of animated 2.5D SVG assets for developer documentation and project pages.
imMamdouhaboammar/vibe-svgs.problem: Developer READMEs often rely on generic badges or inconsistent AI-made illustrations that break accessibility, motion, or inline SVG safety.
imMamdouhaboammar/vibe-svgs.goal: Provide expressive reusable SVG mascots, badges, scenes, and banners with clear accessibility and technical contracts.
imMamdouhaboammar/vibe-svgs.audience: Open-source maintainers, developer-tool builders, technical writers, and AI-assisted design workflows.

imMamdouhaboammar/conversion-copywriting.name: Conversion Copywriting Engine
imMamdouhaboammar/conversion-copywriting.description: A structured conversion-copywriting system packaged as an agent skill and Claude plugin.
imMamdouhaboammar/conversion-copywriting.problem: Generic AI copy skips product analysis, customer psychology, market dialects, funnel context, and the quality checks used in real campaign delivery.
imMamdouhaboammar/conversion-copywriting.goal: Turn seven-plus years of campaign practice into a repeatable research, strategy, writing, and copy-audit workflow.
imMamdouhaboammar/conversion-copywriting.audience: Copywriters, marketers, agencies, founders, and AI agents working across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, MENA, and Canada.

imMamdouhaboammar/PatchPilot.name: PatchPilot
imMamdouhaboammar/PatchPilot.description: A PR-only operating kit for disciplined GitHub repository work from ChatGPT Web.
imMamdouhaboammar/PatchPilot.problem: Chat-based repository work can touch default branches, mix unrelated changes, or claim tests without evidence when the operating boundary is vague.
imMamdouhaboammar/PatchPilot.goal: Make ChatGPT inspect live repository state, create focused branches and commits, open review-ready pull requests, and stop before merge.
imMamdouhaboammar/PatchPilot.audience: Open-source maintainers and developers preparing bounded GitHub changes from ChatGPT Web.
